lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.34 - A Look and learn

details: Look and learn helps students review and consolidate the main grammatical structures of the unit, covering meaning form & pronunciation.
Look for accurate and confident reading and repetition of both questions and answers, paying specific attention to the demonstrative pronouns, the ‘‘s’ in ‘It’s’ and the pronunciation of ‘they’re’.
“We’ve got some animals joining our class today! Can you help them all feel welcome?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.34 - B. Circle and write

details: Circle and write challenges students to correctly discriminate between the four demonstrative pronouns, and tests their written production of the animal vocabulary (singular and plural forms) in a controlled practice activity.
Look for correct choices of demonstrative pronoun and correct choice of vocabulary (in singular and plural forms).
“There’s some more animals outside the window, waiting to come and join us. Can you spot them all?”

Heads Down:

Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
